sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 400. Success value 100. 3x to 6x magic damage (Time).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Karma.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces all stats by 80% for 100 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge gains by 3 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 100 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Domination Collapse (nullifies the target's buffs, reduces the target's critical hit chance to zero, and increases Ability Power of damage taken by the target by 30) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 15000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 15000
